title: Fortissimo - Pool - Gym - Mins to Broadway
description:
Welcome to Fortissimo, your Music Row stay where city energy and effortless comfort come together. Spend your days soaking up the sun at the heated pool, unwinding in the stylish lobby lounge, or stepping out onto your private balcony as the city comes to life. Walk to Vanderbilt, explore the shops and cafés of 12 South, or dive into Broadway’s live music, bars, and nightlife. After a full day out, come back to relax, recharge, and get ready to do it all again.

The space
⭐ Building Accommodations & Amenities:
- Just a 15-minute walk to Broadway, putting you steps from Nashville’s iconic live music scene, buzzing honky-tonks, rooftop bars, and unforgettable nights out
- Prime location just 1 minute to Vanderbilt University and 3 minutes to Belmont University, putting you right in the heart of campus life
- Heated pool with skyline views, loungers, and cabanas—made for sun-filled afternoons and relaxing evenings (open year-round 8 AM–10 PM, HOA discretion)
- Stylish lobby with comfortable seating and a resident game lounge, perfect for hanging out, socializing, and keeping the energy going
- State-of-the-art fitness and yoga center open from 5 AM to 12 AM, making it easy to fit in a workout whenever it works for you
- Pet-friendly building with a gated pet area and dog wash station, so your pup can enjoy the trip too
- Poolside lounge and cabanas available for private event rentals—perfect for celebrating or elevating your stay (inquire at booking)
- Private balcony with outdoor seating, perfect for morning coffee, fresh air, and unwinding as the city lights start to glow
- Elevator access and secured entry for a smooth, easy experience from arrival to departure
- 24/7 front desk with hotel-style check-in that gives your stay a seamless, elevated feel from the moment you arrive

🛋️ Living Area:
- Open-concept living area that brings everyone together, perfect for relaxing, hanging out, and easing into your Nashville stay
- Sink-in cozy furnishings that make it easy to kick back, unwind, and stay awhile after a day out
- Smart TV ready for movie nights, game days, or keeping something on while everyone hangs out
- Spacious coffee table perfect for drinks, snacks, and easy, laid-back evenings in
- Direct access to your private balcony, ideal for fresh air, morning coffee, or winding down as the city lights come on

🍽️ Kitchen & Dining:
- Fully equipped kitchen that keeps the energy going, whether you're fueling up before heading out or coming back for late-night bites
- Sleek stainless steel appliances that give the space a clean, elevated feel while keeping everything easy and within reach
- Full appliance setup including a fridge, dishwasher, oven, 4-burner stove, microwave, and toaster—ready for anything from quick snacks to casual meals with your group
- Spacious counters that give you plenty of room to prep, plate, and keep things moving without feeling crowded
- Cozy dining space for 2, ideal for coffee, casual meals, or a quick reset between Nashville plans
- Keurig coffee maker stocked and ready, so you can start your day right or recharge before heading back out
- Kitchen Starter Kit: 1 sponge, 2 paper towels, 2 regular coffees, 1 vanilla coffee, 1 decaf coffee, 4 condiments, 1 dish soap, and 2 teas

🛌 Bedrooms:
- Primary Bedroom: Queen bed with a smart TV, closet space, and an en-suite bathroom
- 2nd Bedroom: Queen bed with a smart TV, closet space, and a Jack-n-Jill en-suite bathroom

🛁 Bathrooms:
- Primary Bathroom: Single vanity with a stand-in shower
- 2nd Bathroom: Jack-n-Jill bathroom with a single vanity and a stand-in shower

🚗 Parking:
- Paid street parking available
- Valet parking available

Additional House Rules:
- Booking guests must be at least 21 years old.
- Same-day move-ins shall not be honored after 10 am Arizona Time.
- GoodNight Stay LLC does not allow local residents to book homes. A local resident is defined as any guest whose primary residence is located within 2 hours of the rented property.
- All guests with a confirmed criminal record shall be declined and asked to cancel the booking at their own expense.
- The guest agrees to provide identity authentication via a third-party platform operating for GoodNight Stay. They will authenticate the name, address, phone number, and photo ID verification. If this is not provided within 48 hours of booking, GoodNight Stay has the right to cancel the booking without penalty.
- Maximum of 2 pets under 35lbs each, $100 fee per pet required.
- Unfortunately, additional starter kit items cannot be provided upon request, as these are to kick-start your stay.
- All listed amenities are to be used at the guest’s risk. The homeowner and GoodNight Stay are not liable in any way for the risk, danger, injury, or damages caused to the other party.
- Parties, events, or weddings are not allowed.

Before booking, please review the full property description and house rules to ensure this home is the right fit for your stay. By completing your reservation, you acknowledge that you have read the listing details and agree to our terms and conditions.
